{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=3|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Second Yemeni Civil War]]
**At least 1,000 Saudi-led coalition forces are reported killed or captured after being [[Encirclement|enveloped]] and [[Battle of the Jabara Valley|besieged in the Jabara Valley]], Saada Governorate, [[Yemen]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/i-curse-myself-everyday-yemeni-mercenaries-say-their-saudi-fighting-days-are-over (MiddleEastEye)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Institute for Supply Management]] releases numbers that indicate that manufacturing activity in the [[United States]] declined in the month of August, the first such decline in three years. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-economy/u-s-manufacturing-shrinks-for-first-time-in-three-years-idUSKCN1VO1RH (Reuters)]
*[[Aftermath of the 2019 El Paso shooting]]
**[[Walmart]] announces it will stop selling ammunition for [[handguns]] and some [[assault weapons]] in all of its American stores in response to a shooting that killed 22 and injured 24 at one of its [[El Paso, Texas]] stores last month. It and [[Kroger]] also ask customers not to bring guns into the stores. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-walmart-guns/walmart-to-stop-selling-ammunition-for-handguns-assault-style-weapons-idUSKCN1VO26X?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Sinking of MV Conception|Sinking of MV ''Conception'']]
**[[Search and rescue]] efforts for those remaining missing off the [[California]]n coastline are called off as the [[National Transportation Safety Board]] arrives to launch a federal investigation. [https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/local/NTSB-Begins-Probe-Into-Deadly-Scuba-Boat-Fire-Off-SoCal-Coast-559305231.html (NBC Los Angeles)]
*[[2019 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Prime Minister of the Bahamas|Bahamian Prime Minister]] [[Hubert Minnis]] confirms two more people have been killed by [[Hurricane Dorian]], raising the death toll to seven. [https://6abc.com/weather/bahamas-pm-says-dorian-death-toll-climbs-to-7/5510937/ (Associated Press)]

;International relations
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**The U.S. State Department announces sanctions against the [[Iranian Space Agency]], [[Iranian Space Research Center]] and Aeronautics Research Institute. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-09/04/c_138362710.htm (Xinhua)]

;Law and crime
*[[Xenophobia in South Africa]], [[2019 Johannesburg riots]]
**A wave of xenophobic attacks on migrants and foreign owned businesses in [[South Africa]], particularly targeting [[Nigeria]]n citizens, continues into its sixth day. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/xenophobic-attacks-shame-south-africa-192011946.html (Yahoo News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Asma Mohamed Abdalla]] is appointed [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Sudan)|Foreign Minister]] of [[Sudan]], becoming the first woman to hold that office. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/sudan-cabinet-bashir-announced-48-hours-190903140751817.html (''Al Jazeera English'')]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]], [[Brexit]]
**British MP [[Phillip Lee (politician)|Phillip Lee]] defects from the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] to the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]], leaving [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] without a working majority in the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/philip-lee-tory-lib-dem-defection-boris-johnson-majority-brexit-commons-a9090356.html (''The Independent'')]
**The House of Commons votes to allow an attempt to stop a no-deal Brexit. All 21 Conservative MPs who voted with the opposition have their [[party whip]] removed and now sit as independents. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-49573555 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Italian government formation]]
**[[Five Star Movement]] members agree to join a coalition with the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/09/03/members-of-itay-s-five-star-movement-vote-79-in-favour-of-coalition-with-democratic-party (Euronews)]
*[[Gerrymandering in the United States]], [[Redistricting in North Carolina]]
**A [[North Carolina]] state court rules the [[North Carolina's congressional districts|state legislative map]] drawn up by the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]]-majority [[North Carolina General Assembly|state legislature]] violates the [[Constitution of North Carolina|state constitution]], and must be redrawn in time for the [[2020 United States elections|2020 elections]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-carolina-gerrymandering/north-carolina-court-strikes-down-state-legislative-map-as-unconstitutional-gerrymander-idUSKCN1VO2MD (Reuters)]
*[[National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States]], [[Mexico–United States barrier]]
**[[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] approves to redistribute US$ 3.6 billion from military construction to 11 new [[Trump wall|border wall]] projects. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2019/09/03/Pentagon-agrees-to-reallocate-36B-for-border-wall-projects/1971567552236/ (UPI News)]
